review_type: Author source/statement review plus independent child proofs of falling-factorial and coefficient prerequisites; no independent whole-chain review is claimed.
scope: Only new conditional scalar R18-R23 normalization chain; no broad historical audit.
reviewed_claims: The raw predicate has every gap s>=0,e>0,s+e<=rho and every r>=9; j<r has loss j+1, giving exactly the R18 sum. No normalized bound occurs in the predicate.
All profile values used lie in [0,rho]. The selected horizon r<ell ensures ell>=1 and (r+1)rho/ell<=rho.
Falling factorial is the exact real cast of Nat.descFactorial, identified using positive factorial denominator; its bound is h^j*r!/(r-j)!<=rho^j<=1 for j<=r<ell.
The lower-norm comparison uses (r-j+1)h<=rh and N_q(t)<=N_q(s) for s<=t. This is the correct direction for shrinking boxes.
All multiplication of inequalities by profile factors uses their nonnegativity explicitly. Inverse-gap cancellation uses h>0; no undefined positive-gap step is used.
The source h^r*F*A^r*r! is bounded by (F+H0)*A^r. Base indices r<9 are exactly r<=8, and h<=1 preserves the base bound.
The first two geometric terms dominate the two preceding-order terms. Doubling the full sum is a valid overestimate with the same B=2CA: 2C*A^j<=B^j for positive j.

Amplitude majorant uses a finite horizon and strong induction with strictly smaller natural indices. Its exact finite convolution comes from the sealed root theorem; no infinite geometric series is substituted.
Final ell=r+1 gives the exact endpoint rho, not an interior grid point. Division is solely by positive h^r. r=0 is included.
S=F+H0=0 is handled without division by S. Final upper bound zero combined with nonnegative N gives N_r(rho)=0.
Expanded root statements retain the raw recurrence, nonnegativity, monotonicity and low-order base assumptions; they do not discharge the actual PDE recurrence.
The source definitions grushinGridNorm and GrushinScalarFixedGapRecurrence were inspected, since expanded type printing alone does not unfold their bodies.
